Kill [[Zaln the Jaded]].

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
Must have access to [[Lion's Arch Keep]], see [[:File:War in Kryta flow chart.png|flowchart]] for details.

===Objectives===
*Gain passage to [[D'Alessio Seaboard (explorable area)|D'Alessio Seaboard]] and kill [[Zaln the Jaded]]
* *BONUS* Kill Zaln the Jaded in [[Hard Mode]]
*See Princess Salma for your reward

===Reward===
*3,000 [[Experience]]
*750 [[Gold]]
*Complete the Base Objective for 10 [[War Supplies]]
*Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 5 War Supplies

==Walkthrough==
Talk to [[Jiaju Tai]] in [[Lions Arch]] to gain access to [[D'Alessio Seaboard (explorable area)]]. The party will spawn at the beach south of the village [[Hakewood]].

If any party member has [[Temple of the Intolerable]] active, there are no hostile White Mantle inside the village. Talk to [[Dinas]] (at the west gate), then leave the village through the northern gate.
Otherwise, the party will have to fight through the village. Avoid engaging multiple groups at once.

Zaln the Jaded can be found just north of Hakewood, along with a small mob of White Mantle and a [[Jade Cloak]] or a [[Jade Armor]].

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Wanted by the Shining Blade
:''"[[Zaln the Jaded]] has been training White Mantle mages for years, passing on his expertise in the arcane arts and his utter disregard for collateral damage to his students. Removing Zaln the Jaded would be a great blow to the White Mantle's ability to train new forces. Gain passage to [[D'Alessio Seaboard]] from [[Jiaju Tai]] in [[Lion's Arch]] and teach this malevolent mentor a lesson in pain! Queen Salma will generously compensate those who undertake this challenge."''
;After completion of The Battle for Lion's Arch
:''"Relive the classic event from the War in Kryta! Zaln the Jaded trained White Mantle mages for years, passing on his expertise in the arcane arts and his utter disregard for collateral damage to all of his students. Until he was permanently removed from Tyria by bounty hunters, Zaln the Jaded was a great thorn in the side of the rebel movement. Recreate this historical scenario; gain passage to D'Alessio Seaboard from Jiaju Tai in Lion's Arch, and teach this malevolent mentor a lesson in pain! Those who successfully re-create this historical battle will earn the Queen's bounty!"''
{{Offer dialog
| accept = I'll do whatever I can to help restore order to Kryta.
| decline = War! What is it good for?
| ask = [[Zaln the Jaded]] is traveling through [[D'Alessio Seaboard]]. Apprehend and eliminate him before he can train more murderous White Mantle disciples. Jiaju Tai in Lion's Arch will grant you safe passage to a safe part of the seaboard.
}}
